تزدرعون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِعُونَ (tazdariʕūna) /taz.da.ri.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# تُزْدَرَعُونَ (tuzdaraʕūna) /tuz.da.ra.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
